databases.description: Named database connections. Each key is the db_ref used in YAML rules/tests.

provider.description: Provider type. Built-ins: oracle, mysql, cassandra. Custom: any registered name.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the database server.

port.description: Port number. Defaults: Oracle=1521, MySQL=3306, Cassandra=9042.

password.description: Password. Prefer env var DB_<NAME_UPPER>_PASSWORD over storing here.

service_name.description: [Oracle only] Oracle service name (alternative to dsn).

dsn.description: [Oracle only] Full DSN string (alternative to host+service_name).

database.description: [MySQL only] Database / schema name to connect to.

contact_points.description: [Cassandra only] One or more contact point hostnames.

keyspace.description: [Cassandra only] Default keyspace to use after connecting.

ssl_config.description: TLS/SSL settings for the database connection.

ca_certs.description: Path to CA certificate bundle (PEM). Used by MySQL and Cassandra.

certfile.description: Path to client certificate file (PEM). Used by MySQL and Cassandra.

keyfile.description: Path to client private key file (PEM). Used by MySQL and Cassandra.

verify_cert.description: [MySQL] Whether to verify the server certificate.

check_hostname.description: [Cassandra] Whether to check the server hostname against the certificate.

wallet_password.description: [Oracle] Wallet password. Prefer env var DB_<NAME_UPPER>_WALLET_PASSWORD.

ssl_server_dn_match.description: [Oracle] Whether to match the server certificate DN.

ssl_server_cert_dn.description: [Oracle] Expected Distinguished Name of the server certificate.

acquire_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for a free connection before raising TimeoutError.

validate_on_borrow.description: Check is_connected() before lending a connection; reconnect if stale.
